fact: In July 2026 the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education and the Ministry of Health signed an MoU to link the EMIS with the HMIS, with a joint technical working group to oversee implementation; the story states the linkage is planned, not yet running.

The University of Oslo DHIS2 for Education country use case says separate databases for HR, examinations and infrastructure exist, with no comprehensive database bringing different data sources together for cross-analysis and planning.
system: Fragmented HR, examinations and infrastructure databases alongside the paper-based Annual School Census EMIS
